34.t: Allows game settings to be changed. Ranges are shown in parentheses (). Default values are shown by * =.
SELECT WITH SERVICE BUTTON AND PRESS TEST BUTTON }
1. Press the Service or View Change Buttons to move the cursor = and bring it to the desired item.
2. Press the Test or Start Button to change the setting.
3. After the desired setting is selected, bring the cursor © to EXIT and press the Test Button.
(A) GAME DIFFICULTY * = NORMAL Sets the game’s overall difficulty (WERY EASY, EASY, NORMAL, HARD, HARDEST).
(B) RACE MODE * = NORMAL Sets the lap length per Table 8 (NORMAL, LONG).
Table 8: Race Mode Lap Lengths INDY 500 HIGHLAND | BAY SIDE | Normal 4 Laps 3 Laps Long 20 Laps 15 Laps
(C) HANDICAP * =ON Speeds up the cars that are in position No. 2 or lower (all cars except position No. 1) in linked play (ON, OFF).
(D) ADVERTISE SOUND *=ON Determines whether ADVERTISE SOUND is to be emitted or not during Standby Mode (ON, OFF).
(E) COUNTRY *=USA Selects message language (JPN, EXP, USA).

40.t: Allows the Control Range (“Volume”) of the Gas and Brake Pedals and Steering Wheel to be adjusted.
SELECT WITH SERVICE BUTTON AND PRESS TEST BUTTON
1. To set the Steering Wheel or Pedal (Gas or Brake) values, bring the cursor “Set & Exit”.

2. To cancel, bring the cursor “Cancel & Exit”. Note: if the Steering Wheel or either Pedal is moved even the slightest while you are in this menu, all the settings will be erased. Sega recommends that all settings be reset anytime this menu is entered.
2. Step on the Gas or Brake Pedal fully, then release completely.
3. Turn the Steering Wheel fully to the left and right (see Figure 20) and allow the Steering Wheel to return to level center, as shown in Figure 21.
4. Press the Test Button to store values and return to the Test Menu.
